headings: # Phase 5 — Design, security findings and configuration defaults
## Preflight review (existing behaviour verified from source and tests)
limitations: | J1 | During testing, injected input stopped reaching any low-level hook. Root cause: a system process window (`GameInputSvc.exe`) held the foreground and Windows UIPI withholds injected input from lower-integrity senders. An initial hypothesis that importing `pywinauto` broke the hook was **disproved** (the hook works with `pywinauto` loaded once the disposable window has focus). The test now focuses its own window and skips as BLOCKED if it cannot. | Resolved; documented |
